title: SKILL FIRST · SOUTHPAW SPORT ROUNDS
featuredMode: Shadow or bag → cable + kettlebell → sport rounds
emphasis: Continue Friday’s planned southpaw step–1–2–reset sequence at the same stage. Today the sport rounds are the priority; rebuild the stance after every exchange instead of adding combinations.

ignition.name: Moving Southpaw Round Prep
ignition.prescription: Move continuously: 2 min relaxed southpaw stance and forward/back steps, 2 min right-lead step-outs with hand recovery, then 1 min easy jab–cross followed by a complete stance reset. Demo unavailable.
ignition.home: Move continuously: 2 min relaxed southpaw stance and forward/back steps, 2 min right-lead step-outs with hand recovery, then 1 min easy jab–cross followed by a complete stance reset. Demo unavailable.
ignition.away: Use the same unloaded sequence in a clear space.
ignition.cue: Make the right lead foot organize every exchange.

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: SKILL · FIND THE ROUND RHYTHM
deposits.effort: One uninterrupted 5-min technical block. No rep target; flow only as fast as the stance can reset cleanly.

exercises.name: Southpaw Right-Lead Step → 1–2 → Stance Reset
exercises.prescription: Shadowbox or work the bag continuously: right-lead step, relaxed right jab–left cross, hands and feet recover, full stance reset. Unresisted is the default. If already familiar, Dopa Boxing Footwork is optional and must not change stance or timing. Brand drill: https://dopamineo.com/boxing-footwork-workout-with-dopa-resistance-band/
exercises.home: Shadowbox or work the bag continuously: right-lead step, relaxed right jab–left cross, hands and feet recover, full stance reset. Unresisted is the default. If already familiar, Dopa Boxing Footwork is optional and must not change stance or timing. Brand drill: https://dopamineo.com/boxing-footwork-workout-with-dopa-resistance-band/
exercises.away: Shadowbox the same complete step, 1–2 and stance-reset sequence continuously.
exercises.cue: Finish every exchange back in a usable southpaw stance.
exercises.equipment: Heavy bag or open floor; Dopa optional

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: SUPPORT · HOLD THE STANCE
deposits.effort: Light quality support after yesterday’s rotational work. Keep 2–3 clean reps in reserve; no load progression is prescribed.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.cue: Keep the ribs and pelvis quiet while the hands move.
exercises.prescription: 6 controlled presses per side. Each 30-sec side window is pacing only, never AMRAP. Resist the cable’s pull so the stance stays organized while the hands work.
exercises.home: 6 controlled presses per side. Each 30-sec side window is pacing only, never AMRAP. Resist the cable’s pull so the stance stays organized while the hands work.
exercises.away: Use 6 slow press-out isometrics per side with a towel or no resistance.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.cue: Stay tall and let neither side pull you out of stance.
exercises.prescription: Carry 30 sec per side with a manageable kettlebell or dumbbell. This is timed posture work, not counted reps. Use quiet steps and stop before leaning.
exercises.home: Carry 30 sec per side with a manageable kettlebell or dumbbell. This is timed posture work, not counted reps. Use quiet steps and stop before leaning.
exercises.away: Use a loaded backpack or another familiar one-sided carry.

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: SPORT ROUNDS · SOUTHPAW RESET
deposits.effort: 3 min controlled bag or shadow work, then 1 min full reset. Technical pace; no conditioning sprint.

exercises.name: Southpaw Step-and-Reset Sport Round
exercises.prescription: Round 1: right-lead step and jab, reset. Round 2: right-lead step and 1–2, reset. Round 3: alternate jab or 1–2, always reset. Round 4: controlled free rhythm using only those choices. Shadow or bag; keep defense and stance intact. Demo unavailable.
exercises.home: Round 1: right-lead step and jab, reset. Round 2: right-lead step and 1–2, reset. Round 3: alternate jab or 1–2, always reset. Round 4: controlled free rhythm using only those choices. Shadow or bag; keep defense and stance intact. Demo unavailable.
exercises.away: Shadowbox the same four southpaw round focuses in a clear space.
exercises.cue: The exchange ends only when your hands and feet are home.

levels.floor: 10:00 · 2 min moving southpaw prep + 5 min uninterrupted timed step–1–2–reset flow + 3 min support: 1×6/side Pallof press with setup/reset
levels.standard: 35:40 · includes setup, side switches and rest

weekSummary: Moving southpaw prep → continuous rhythm skill → light stance support → four focused sport rounds
